properties.name: Two detectors added: multiple_parents (a Component contained by more than one parent — the spine is a tree) and level_spine_disagreement (a Component at the root of the spine declaring a level something else claims to be above). Both were invisible before, and both fire on this design: cmp:skills has two parents, cmp:packaging and cmp:registry are the spurious 'tier 1'. The second check is self-limiting — it compares against the highest level PRESENT, so a flat design reports nothing and no ladder depth is prescribed.
